title: ESI DSL artifact
description: A stored ESI DSL artifact (ADR-0002): the A2UI v0.9 updateComponents component list plus the columns and SELECT it is bound to. It never contains row values or layout. Tables and KPIs use the basic catalog; charts use the ESI catalog (ADR-0009).

dslSchemaVersion.description: Version of the artifact format; see DSL_SCHEMA_VERSIONS in versions.ts for the A2UI pair it maps to.

protocolVersion.description: A2UI message version used when the artifact is rendered.

catalogId.description: The pinned basic catalog id (verbatim from catalog.json), or the ESI catalog id (esi/catalog.json) for an artifact with a chart.

columns.description: Columns of the bound query result that the components may reference.

sql.description: The SELECT the artifact is bound to.

components.description: The A2UI updateComponents.components payload; its items are components of the artifact's catalog.
An ESI catalog artifact has at least one EsiChart; tables and KPIs use the basic catalog.

name.description: Column key as returned by the query; used as a JSON Pointer segment, so '/' and '~' are not allowed.
